host.label: WeatherLink Live 6100 IP address
host.help: Local IP address of the WeatherLink Live 6100 device, e.g. 192.168.1.50

discoverButton.label: Find WeatherLink Live 6100
discoverButton.help: Searches the local network for a WeatherLink Live 6100 via mDNS/Bonjour and fills in its IP address and port automatically

error.notFound: No WeatherLink Live 6100 found on the local network. Make sure the device and this ioBroker host are on the same network and multicast is not blocked, then enter the IP address manually.
error.discoveryFailed: Discovery failed, see the adapter log for details.

pollInterval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: Minimum 10 seconds as required by the WeatherLink Live 6100 Local API

units.label: Units
units.help: The WeatherLink Live 6100 always reports values in imperial units; select "Metric" to convert temperature (°C), wind speed (km/h) and pressure (hPa) before storing them

cloudCoverInfo.text: Cloud cover and the current weather icon are estimated from a solar radiation sensor (if present), using this ioBroker installation's location (Admin -> System settings). Without a configured location or a solar sensor, a rougher estimate based on dew point (and pressure trend, if a barometer is present) is used instead. If neither is possible, no cloud cover or weather icon value is created.

realtimeEnabled.label: Enable real-time mode (UDP broadcast)
realtimeEnabled.help: Requests the WeatherLink Live 6100 to broadcast wind and rain data every 2.5s over UDP

realtimeDuration.label: Real-time broadcast duration (seconds)
realtimeDuration.help: Duration requested per activation; will be renewed automatically. Max 86400
